meta.chain_source: MLE fit to tedsd_puf_2024.csv; STFIPS=6; outpatient (SERVICES_D 6-7); co_occurring_only=False. Spanish-preferring patients use the Hispanic chain.

latino_share: TEDS-D 2024: Hispanic share of CA outpatient episodes is 47.6% statewide; across 18 metros with 500+ episodes it runs 7.0% to 86.0%. Range = Sacramento (26.7%) to Salinas (64.8%).
spanish_pref_share: CA Latinos age 5+, ACS 2021 via CHCF Latino Health Almanac: 15% speak English 'not well' or 'not at all'; 27% speak it less than 'very well' (Census definition, the base). High: San Benito County Behavioral Health, where 64% of SUD clients are Latino and about 1 in 4 clients prefers Spanish (25/64 = 39%).
caseload_per_clinician: Outpatient SUD counselor survey: mean caseload 30, range 6-42 (Addict Sci Clin Pract 2021); New Jersey outpatient staffing standard 1:35.
offered_load: Assumption: referrals relative to capacity. Base 0.95 keeps the clinic near the 85% occupancy implied by N-SUMHSS (about 76 outpatient clients per CA facility vs 90 slots).
renege_prob: Waitlist tolerance about one month, about 40% leave within two weeks (Kaplan & Johri 2000, cited in Redko et al. 2006). Weekly 1-exp(-7/30) = 0.21.
wait_log_or_per_week: Base: TEDS-D 2024 CA logistic fit, episode dropout OR 1.030 per week waited, converted to an effect on weekly dropout odds during the first 4 weeks in care (0.091 per week waited). High: NIATx session-4 attendance 68.2% at 0 days vs 40.8% at 30 days (Hoffman et al. 2011), which needs 0.353.
turnover_annual: Counselor turnover 33.2% per year in 27 SUD treatment organizations (Eby et al. 2010); earlier estimates they cite run 19% to 50%.
vacancy_weeks_general: County behavioral health hiring often takes one to three months (Santa Cruz County Civil Grand Jury 2023). Base two months.
bilingual_vacancy_factor: Assumption: bilingual posts take longer to fill. No published figure found; base 1.5x.

meta.clinic_size_note: N-SUMHSS 2023 California: 70,614 clients in outpatient SUD treatment across 933 outpatient facilities, about 76 per facility. Three clinicians at caseload 30 = 90 slots.
